messages:
maya: Quick flag 1: Ruby sampleapp raises generic APIError for 429s. Node/Go raise `RateLimitError` with `retry_after_ms`. Breaking parity in our onboarding examples.

sam: Thanks for flagging. Which endpoint? streaming or sync generate?

maya: /v1/generate (sync). Example Ruby: `raise APIError.new(resp.body)` no parsed fields.

alex: We should agree a canonical envelope and have SDKs normalize legacy responses into typed exceptions.

noah: Proposed envelope: {\"error\":{\"message\":\"Too many requests\",\"code\":\"rate_limit\",\"retry_after_ms\":2000,\"retryable\":true,\"meta\":{}}} . SDKs map code->class.

maya: Perfect. For compatibility: SDKs should offer `normalize_errors: true|false` opt-in in minor release, default false, flip in next major. Avoid breaking users.

sam: Owner callouts? Alex can do Go tests, Maya you take Ruby adapter + tests, I to update shared SDK error mapping doc.

alex: I'll add e2e in sampleapps that hits a fixture server returning both legacy and envelope bodies and assert same exception class + attributes. ETA Tue.

noah: I'll implement Python normalizer helper too and make streaming clients emit `on_error(err, partial_text)` with normalized err.

ci-bot: Created ticket INFR-1593: "error-envelope + sdk normalization parity tests" assigned to alex,maya,noah. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFR-1593

maya: Added a short docs stub under SDK -> Errors showing try/catch by class and checking `error.code`. Will send for copy edit.

sam: Nice. Small UX note: keep `message` end-user safe and put internal details into `meta`. Also include `retry_after_ms` and `retryable`.

alex: Sounds good. We'll sync status in SDK sync on Thursday.

maya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
